00_kpis:
-- KPIs gerais do período. "Pedidos válidos" exclui cancelados e indisponíveis.
WITH valid_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
),
order_revenue AS (
    SELECT v.order_id, SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) AS revenue
    FROM valid_orders v
    JOIN order_items i USING (order_id)
    GROUP BY v.order_id
),
delivered AS (
    SELECT (order_delivered_customer_date::date > order_estimated_delivery_date::date) AS is_late
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_revenue)                                AS orders,
    (SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) FROM order_revenue)                  AS revenue,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(revenue), 2) FROM order_revenue)                  AS avg_ticket,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id)
       FROM valid_orders v JOIN customers c USING (customer_id))        AS customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FROM order_items)                 AS sellers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products)                                     AS products,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 3) FROM order_reviews)             AS avg_score,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(is_late::int), 4) FROM delivered)                 AS late_rate,
    (SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(order_purchase_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM valid_orders) AS period_start,
    (SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(order_purchase_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM valid_orders) AS period_end;
01_atraso_vs_review:
-- Pergunta 1: o atraso na entrega afeta a nota do review? Em quanto?
-- Pedidos entregues com review. Quando há mais de um review, vale o mais recente.
WITH latest_review AS (
    SELECT order_id,
           review_score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY review_answer_timestamp DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM order_reviews
),
delivered AS (
    SELECT r.review_score,
           o.order_delivered_customer_date::date
             - o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date AS delay_days
    FROM orders o
    JOIN latest_review r ON r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.rn = 1
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT review_score,
           CASE
               WHEN delay_days <= 0  THEN 0
               WHEN delay_days <= 3  THEN 1
               WHEN delay_days <= 7  THEN 2
               WHEN delay_days <= 14 THEN 3
               ELSE 4
           END AS bucket
    FROM delivered
)
SELECT bucket,
       CASE bucket
           WHEN 0 THEN 'on_time'
           WHEN 1 THEN 'late_1_3'
           WHEN 2 THEN 'late_4_7'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'late_8_14'
           ELSE 'late_15_plus'
       END                                                  AS bucket_id,
       COUNT(*)                                             AS orders,
       ROUND(AVG(review_score), 3)                          AS avg_score,
       ROUND(AVG((review_score <= 2)::int), 4)              AS negative_rate,
       ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4)  AS share_of_orders
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;
02a_receita_por_estado:
-- Pergunta 2a: receita, pedidos e ticket médio por estado do cliente.
-- Receita = preço + frete dos itens; exclui pedidos cancelados e indisponíveis.
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT c.customer_state,
           o.order_id,
           SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
    JOIN order_items i USING (order_id)
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_state, o.order_id
)
SELECT customer_state                                       AS state,
       COUNT(*)                                             AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2)                               AS revenue,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue), 2)                               AS avg_ticket,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue) / SUM(SUM(revenue)) OVER (), 4)   AS revenue_share,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC)             AS revenue_rank
FROM order_revenue
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
02b_receita_por_categoria:
-- Pergunta 2b: receita e ticket médio por categoria de produto, com curva de Pareto.
-- avg_ticket = receita da categoria / pedidos que contêm a categoria.
WITH item_revenue AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(p.product_category_name, 'sem_categoria')    AS category_pt,
           COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english,
                    p.product_category_name, 'uncategorized')     AS category_en,
           i.order_id,
           i.price + i.freight_value                              AS revenue
    FROM order_items i
    JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
    JOIN products p USING (product_id)
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t
           ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
),
by_category AS (
    SELECT category_pt,
           category_en,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
           COUNT(*)                 AS items,
           SUM(revenue)             AS revenue
    FROM item_revenue
    GROUP BY category_pt, category_en
)
SELECT category_pt,
       category_en,
       orders,
       items,
       ROUND(revenue, 2)                             AS revenue,
       ROUND(revenue / orders, 2)                    AS avg_ticket,
       ROUND(revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 4)      AS revenue_share,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
             / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 4)              AS cumulative_share
FROM by_category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
03a_vendas_mensais:
-- Pergunta 3a: evolução mensal de pedidos e receita, com crescimento mês a mês.
-- Recorte jan/2017 a ago/2018: fora dele o dataset tem cobertura parcial.
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                             AS orders,
           SUM(i.price + i.freight_value)                         AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i USING (order_id)
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(month, 'YYYY-MM')                                   AS month,
       orders,
       ROUND(revenue, 2)                                           AS revenue,
       ROUND(revenue / orders, 2)                                  AS avg_ticket,
       ROUND(revenue / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) - 1, 4)  AS revenue_mom,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (
           ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ), 2)                                                       AS revenue_ma3
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;
03b_vendas_dia_hora:
-- Pergunta 3b: em que dia da semana e hora os clientes mais compram?
-- dow segue ISO: 1 = segunda ... 7 = domingo.
SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS dow,
       EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int   AS hour,
       COUNT(*)                                           AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
03c_dias_de_pico:
-- Pergunta 3c: dias com maior volume de pedidos e quanto superam a média diária.
WITH daily AS (
    SELECT order_purchase_timestamp::date AS day,
           COUNT(*)                       AS orders
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
      AND order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD')              AS day,
       orders,
       ROUND(orders / AVG(orders) OVER (), 2)  AS vs_daily_avg
FROM daily
ORDER BY orders DESC
LIMIT 5;
04_rfm_base:
-- Pergunta 4 (base do RFM): recência, frequência e valor monetário por cliente único.
-- A pontuação e os segmentos são calculados em src/rfm.py.
-- Data de referência = dia seguinte à última compra do dataset.
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.order_purchase_timestamp,
           SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
    JOIN order_items i USING (order_id)
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
),
reference AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)::date + 1 AS ref_date
    FROM customer_orders
)
SELECT customer_unique_id,
       r.ref_date - MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)::date  AS recency_days,
       COUNT(*)                                          AS frequency,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2)                            AS monetary
FROM customer_orders
CROSS JOIN reference r
GROUP BY customer_unique_id, r.ref_date;
05_entrega_por_estado:
-- Pergunta 5: tempo de entrega por estado e seu impacto na satisfação.
WITH latest_review AS (
    SELECT order_id,
           review_score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY review_answer_timestamp DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM order_reviews
),
delivered AS (
    SELECT c.customer_state AS state,
           EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM o.order_delivered_customer_date
                              - o.order_purchase_timestamp)::float8 / 86400  AS delivery_days,
           o.order_delivered_customer_date::date
             > o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date                           AS is_late,
           r.review_score
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
    LEFT JOIN latest_review r ON r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.rn = 1
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT state,
       COUNT(*)                                                     AS orders,
       ROUND(AVG(delivery_days)::numeric, 1)                        AS avg_delivery_days,
       ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_days))::numeric, 1)
                                                                    AS median_delivery_days,
       ROUND(AVG(is_late::int), 4)                                  AS late_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(review_score), 3)                                  AS avg_score
FROM delivered
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days;
